messages:
claire.z: FYI planning a small cutover tonight to enable cosign via KMS + enclave attestation for runtime base images. Need quick RBAC review and confirm audit log path.
dan.h: Quick Q: which principal gets kms.sign? buildkite or signer svc SA?
claire.z: signer-service SA only. buildkite triggers can assume via short-lived token but no direct KMS binding.
priya.p: Good. Ensure the KMS audit logs are exported to longterm-syslog and include principalEmail.
tom.l: Found one hiccup in staging: attestation failed when signer pod couldn't read `/etc/attest/roots.pem`. I added a mount but want an admission rule to block soft fallback.
claire.z: Agreed — deny soft-sign in prod via Gatekeeper constraint. PJ for mount fix?
tom.l: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/900 — adds mount + readiness probe.
dan.h: For RBAC I'll prepare minimal IAM binding JSON and post to SEC ticket. No broad iam.bind.
deploy-bot: CHANGE WINDOW REQUIRED: attach rollback runbook before live deploy.
claire.z: Will open SEC-2026-512 and add runbook + KMS policy draft. tom, run the staging canary and post logs to the ticket when ready.
tom.l: staging canary passed after mount fix. cosign sign calls now include attestation annotation.
priya.p: Also add structured log fields: signer.kms_key and signer.attestation_ok. Makes post-incident queries easier.
claire.z: Thanks all — hold prod window until SEC ticket approved and Gatekeeper policy is in place. :white_check_mark:
